import pandas as pd

5.1,3.5,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.9,3.0,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.7,3.2,1.3,0.2,setosa

5.0,3.6,1.4,0.2,setosa"""

sns.set(style="ticks")
pairplot = sns.pairplot(df, hue="species", height=1.5)
pairplot.fig.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("output.png")
